author: 滇西小哥 Dianxi Xiaoge
description:
※Click "cc" on the lower right menu to choose your subtitle language.

This time, I’ve gathered some of the best beef dishes from previous videos into one long compilation that you can sit back and enjoy.

In Yunnan, beef can be prepared in many different ways. Braised, boiled, grilled, or stir-fried, each method brings out a different flavor. Combined with local spices and ingredients, every dish has its own unique character.

From the satisfaction of eating big, hearty pieces of beef to the different textures and flavors of various cuts and cooking styles, this compilation brings them all together in one place.

If you enjoy Yunnan cuisine and beef dishes, come along and experience these mouthwatering flavors of Yunnan.

Hello, everyone! I am Dianxi Xiaoge, a Yunnan native. If you enjoy my videos, please keep subscribing to my channel. I'll continue to share my life and Yunnan-styled food in my uploads. Wish you have a happy life and enjoy tasty food every day
